title: Grocery tools to explore
intro: Soft CTAs for established supermarket and meal patterns when you are modelling everyday food spend. Confirm coverage, hours and offers on each site — this block is not a ranking of chains.

items.reason: Full-service supermarket benchmark — useful when modelling a typical in-store or AH Bezorgen weekly basket.
